_comment: Optional per-module CI overrides. Default bazel command is 'test //... --test_output=errors' on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest. Exit 4 falls back to build //.... Commands mirror each source repo's existing gate (forge/tracker/wave ci.yml; service-finder codegen-drift.yml + bazel tests that exist in-tree). Directory keys match on-disk prefixes (service-finder, not service_finder).

extra.cmd: cargo run -q -p codegen && git diff --quiet -- client/rust/src/generated
